GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped well Wide out pushing on settled Two Wide second (1400m), no change to 600, Under Pressure approaching Turn Quickly gone into the Straight dropped out (unable to be re-plated behind the barriers, therefore Stewards permitted to race with no hind plates) (Nasal Strip FIRST TIME) # spent force turn
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted n/hind plate in mounting yard. When unable to be re-plated permitted to race barefooted behind & vetted. Rdr reported mount became worked up prior to the race, which may have been detrimental to its finishing efforts. Warning for its poor performance.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Restrained from Outside Settled Down Off Mid-Field Outside 6-7 Lengths No Pace On bit keen Ridden Along Turning for home couldn't quicken - # Could Not Keep Up
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Vetted pre-race after contacting fence. Began awkwardly. Over-raced in the early and middle stages. Raced three-wide with cover throughout. Laid in under pressure in the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped well and Went Forward to 2 Lengths joint Lead on fence, Headed 1400m, Held Together behind Lead middle stages, moved back up to Two Wide joint Lead turning, narrow sole Lead Straightening Up , Headed 220m and Lost Ground to the line. (Bubble Cheeker (Off Side) OFF FIRST TIME) # weakened in str.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted in under pressure approaching the 400m and bumped. Shifted out upon entering the home straight and bumped.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out 1 length then worked forward and led Two Wide jointly settling down, held together much same to turn trailing Two Wide by a head, kept trying but lost a couple of lengths in Straight # slow/worked early
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on jumping. Bumped near the 1400m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , sat 3 Wide No Cover Mid Field but working forward 4 Lengths 1000m, took over at 600m and dashed away with Clear lead, Held Together and still held a Clear break on the corner, Just found one better last 200m but he stayed tough and held second spot # overran last 100m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: After being caught wide early, permitted to stride to take up the leading position near the 700m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: stewards said was slow to begin, Restrained thus Settled Down 4th 1x1 3 Lengths following 1st x 2 Lengths No Pace On , Hooked Out 3 Wide x 600 2 Lengths Under Pressure Soon After Straightening Up couldn't quicken and # couldn't finish off
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Crowded and steadied approaching the 50m.
Began awkwardly and shifted outward bumping with MISS ELLYSE shortly after the start. Crowded MISS ELLYSE approaching the 1450m point. Raced wide for the majority.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2.5 Lengths 3 Wide , in Two Wide before the 1000m, Drifted Back to Turn then shifted out to 7 Lengths 3 Wide , Made Some Ground in straight. (Bubble Cheeker (Off Side) FIRST TIME) # never a threat
Jumped Ok , sat on Leaders heels 1 Lengths 800m, Hard Ridden and Beaten before the corner and weakened in Straight # beaten turn
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted out and bumped. Shifted in abruptly passing the 1300m.
